title: Quantum Physics: From Photons to Qubits
description: An introduction to quantum physics that keeps the math honest and runs it on a computer. You will follow the experiments that broke classical physics (blackbody radiation, the photoelectric effect, atomic spectra, electron diffraction) and the ideas that replaced it: photons, the Bohr atom, matter waves, the wave function and Born's rule, the Schrödinger equation, quantized energy levels, tunneling, the uncertainty principle, spin and the Pauli principle. Then the modern view: states and measurement, qubits, superposition and interference, entanglement and Bell's inequality (with the experiments behind the 2022 Nobel Prize), and quantum computing: gates, circuits, Deutsch's algorithm, Grover's search and what Shor's algorithm means for cryptography. Node.js tools compute the early formulas, solve the Schrödinger equation numerically for wells, oscillators and double wells, and simulate a small quantum computer. The project builds and checks three quantum circuits: Deutsch's algorithm, quantum teleportation and Grover search.
